edits.name: 赤枷
edits.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: a standalone transparent inventory illustration for 六子战棋.
Input images: Image 1 is the weapon image to replace and the reference for the series' painted materials and rendering quality. Image 2 is a reference ONLY for 血契's crimson-and-ink-black palette and character mood; never depict the character.
Primary request: Correct 血契's weapon 赤枷 into ONE RED SCYTHE. Completely replace the shackle-and-chain subject in Image 1 with one long-handled reaper scythe. The dominant large curved crescent blade MUST be vivid deep crimson red, forged ruby-red metal with a thin bright red cutting edge; red must cover most of the blade, not merely small gemstone accents on a black or silver blade. Give it a strong dark crimson and ink-black shaft, subtle blackened metal fittings and restrained antique-gold engraving consistent with this collection. A long sweeping single pointed blade curves away from the upper end of the shaft, mounted with a coherent strong physical tang and collar; recognizable scythe silhouette. Fine hand-painted metal textures, refined Chinese fantasy concept art, ornate but readable at thumbnail size.
Composition: square canvas, one complete scythe centered diagonally, balanced three-quarter view, every part fully visible with generous 10 percent transparent margins, no clipping. The blade is the focal point. Soft studio lighting.
Backdrop: genuine alpha transparency; clean naturally antialiased cutout edges. Empty space remains transparent.
Constraints: exactly ONE scythe with ONE crescent blade and ONE long shaft; no chain, no shackle, no cuff, no flail, no detached parts, no second weapon, no person, no hands, no blood splashes, no scene, no paper background, no floor or pedestal, no text, no label, no watermark. Preserve the illustration collection's material quality and transparency.
